concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-auth-connect]] - closed-beta merchant-facing Connect route from a platform button through hosted login or signup, OAuth authorization and return redirect, with login-only and Finish Later boundaries
warnings: Keep Braintree Auth distinct from generic payment-transaction authorization.
Preserve the platform-versus-merchant roles, collected closed-beta qualification and OAuth-scope boundary.
Do not infer current availability, eligibility, completed account connection, token exchange or authorization beyond the merchant-granted scope.
Keep configuration, server-side handling and reference details as navigation-only routes unless separately read.
